Actual operational charges may vary depending on real-time repair order volume, database storage growth, peak SMS/WhatsApp messaging traffic, selected French PDP provider contracts, and client customization preferences.

project_overview.product_category: Automotive Workshop Management SaaS & Central Operating System
project_overview.tagline: The High-Precision Operating System for Modern Automotive Workshops. France 🇫🇷 & Switzerland 🇨🇭.
project_overview.core_mission: Eliminate administrative drag and workshop double-bookings by providing a unified 12ms availability engine, grease-resistant 48px mechanic tablet stations, instant magic-link quote approvals (< 3 min), customer web booking without WhatsApp dependency, and automated French Plateforme Agréée (PA/PDP) / Swiss QR-Bill cross-border billing without ever leaving the SaaS.

target_jurisdictions.e_invoicing_mandate: Factur-X (CII / UBL 2.1) via DGFiP Approved Platforms (PA/PDP, e.g. Pennylane) & Chorus Pro (PPF)
target_jurisdictions.regulatory_compliance: DGFiP 2026/2027 E-Invoicing Reform, RGPD, ISO 27001 Local Storage

target_jurisdictions.e_invoicing_mandate: Swiss QR-Bill (Structured BVR with 27-digit reference + QR-IBAN)
target_jurisdictions.regulatory_compliance: Federal Tax Administration (ESTV), Swiss nLPD (New Federal Act on Data Protection)

core_architectural_principles.name: ONE Central Availability & Scheduling Engine
core_architectural_principles.description: A single availability pipeline shared across garage desktop admin, mechanic bay tablets, public web booking wizards, and AutoAI receptionists. Enforces mechanic skill certifications, physical lift weight ratings, and mandatory 15-minute bay sanitization buffers with 0 double bookings.

core_architectural_principles.name: Internal Invoicing vs Pluggable PDP E-Reporting Connector
core_architectural_principles.description: AtelierOS internally handles parts + labor calculation, deterministic VAT assignment, PDF generation, Factur-X XML packaging, and Swiss QR-Bill rendering. External regulatory dispatch to the DGFiP network is routed via pluggable PDP connectors (Pennylane / Chorus Pro) so garage staff never leave the application.

core_architectural_principles.name: Cross-Border Dynamic Tax Engine (France & Switzerland)
core_architectural_principles.description: Customer profiles support France, Switzerland, and international clients with deterministic tax calculations based on physical repair location, customer residency, and B2B/B2C status with native dual currency (EUR € / CHF CHF).

core_architectural_principles.name: Customer Web Booking Without WhatsApp Dependency
core_architectural_principles.description: Provides a universal 60-second browser booking wizard accessible via SMS or email link that directly queries the central calendar engine.

core_architectural_principles.name: Bounded AI with Typed JSON Function Calling
core_architectural_principles.description: AutoAI receptionist operates strictly through typed JSON tool calls (check_availability, compute_quote, lookup_obd, hold_slot) tied directly to the central engine without a separate calendar.

core_architectural_principles.name: Strict Multi-Tenant Row Level Security (RLS)
core_architectural_principles.description: Guarantees zero cross-tenant data bleed. Every database record, appointment, customer profile, and vehicle record is isolated per garage tenant ID in PostgreSQL via Supabase RLS.

flow_1_central_scheduling.flow_name: Unified Slot Booking & Bay Constraint Resolution Flow
execution_steps: 1. Intake trigger initiated (Web Booking, Front Desk Admin, or AutoAI Receptionist)
2. Service type identified (e.g. Front Brake Pads & Discs replacement -> required skill: BRAKES, required duration: 90 min)
3. Central Engine executes 12ms Constraint Solver:
a. Filter active mechanics having skill 'BRAKES' and working on chosen date
b. Filter available bays supporting vehicle lift specifications (e.g. TWO_POST_LIFT)
c. Validate no existing overlapping work orders
d. Enforce mandatory 15-minute buffer between consecutive bookings
4. Slot temporarily reserved (10-minute hold with countdown timer)
5. Customer contact captured & GDPR consent logged
6. Slot committed -> Work Order WO-2026-xxxx created in Stage 2 (APPOINTMENT)
7. Real-time calendar synchronized via Supabase WebSocket broadcast to all connected tablets & desktop screens

flow_2_mechanic_tablet_and_diagnostic.flow_name: Bay Tablet Inspection, OBD-II Scan & Stopwatch Labor Tracking Flow
execution_steps: 1. Mechanic logs into Bay Tablet (Rugged 48px UI mode)
2. Selects assigned Work Order -> Moves stage from APPOINTMENT to DIAGNOSIS
3. Connects OBD-II scanner -> Enters fault code (e.g. P0300 - Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected)
4. AtelierOS OBD library returns: Severity CRITICAL, Affected System IGNITION/FUEL, Suggested Checks: Spark plugs, ignition coils, fuel injectors
5. Mechanic takes photos of worn components -> Attached directly to Work Order
6. Mechanic starts Labor Stopwatch -> Real-time seconds tracked in background
7. Mechanic completes diagnostic checklist -> Clicks 'Generate Quote Draft' -> Moves stage to Stage 4 (QUOTE)

flow_3_magic_link_quote_approval.flow_name: Zero-Friction Customer Quote Sign-Off Flow (< 3 Minutes)
execution_steps: 1. Garage Admin reviews itemized parts (€250) + labor (€250) + VAT (€100) = Total €600
2. Admin clicks 'Send Magic Approval Link'
3. Brevo Email API + WhatsApp/SMS Gateway dispatches secure tokenized link: https://app.atelier-os.com/approve?token=sec_98f4a1...
4. Work Order transitions to Stage 5 (AWAITING_APPROVAL)
5. Customer opens link on smartphone without logging in
6. Customer inspects itemized parts, labor breakdown, and attached OBD/damage photos
7. Customer draws or types digital authorization signature & clicks 'Approve Quotation'
8. Webhook callback instantly updates AtelierOS:
a. Work Order transitions to Stage 6 (APPROVED)
b. Bay Tablet alerts technician with green notification pulse to commence repair
c. Timestamped audit log recorded for legal compliance

flow_4_e_invoicing_and_pdp_transmission.flow_name: French DGFiP E-Invoicing & Swiss QR-Bill Pipeline Flow
execution_steps: 1. Technician finishes repair, passes 5-point quality checklist, moves to Stage 9 (READY)
2. Customer picks up vehicle -> Work Order transitions to Stage 10 (DELIVERED / INVOICED)
3. AtelierOS Invoicing Engine automatically generates Invoice FAC-FR-2026-0058:
a. Evaluates Deterministic Tax Rules (France Domestic: 20.0% TVA / Switzerland: 8.1% MWST)
b. Compiles CrossIndustryInvoice XML payload compliant with urn:factur-x.eu:1p0:basic (CII/UBL 2.1)
c. Compiles Swiss QR-Bill payment part if Swiss customer (27-digit structured reference + QR-IBAN)
d. Generates visual hybrid PDF invoice
4. Garage Admin clicks 'Transmit to E-Invoicing'
5. Pluggable EInvoiceConnector routes payload to configured provider (Pennylane PDP API v2 / Chorus Pro PISTE):
a. POST /api/v2/customer_invoices with XML + PDF data
b. Provider returns SUBMITTED with external reference: FR-DEMO-2026-0085
c. Invoice status transitions: DRAFT -> VALIDATED -> SUBMITTED -> IN_PROCESSING -> ACCEPTED
6. Webhook received from Pennylane -> AtelierOS marks invoice as ACCEPTED with DGFiP compliance seal

flow_5_auto_ai_function_calling.flow_name: AutoAI Natural Language Receptionist & Bounded Execution Flow
execution_steps: 1. Customer describes symptom: 'My Peugeot 3008 squeaks loudly when braking at low speeds'
2. AutoAI interprets symptom through OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
3. Model triggers internal bounded function check_workshop_availability(service='BRAKE_INSPECTION', date_range=['2026-08-19', '2026-08-21'])
4. Central Engine returns 3 available conflict-free slots on 2-Post Lift with Master Brake Tech
5. AutoAI presents humanized booking options in customer's preferred language (FR/EN/DE)
6. Customer selects preferred slot -> Model calls hold_booking_slot(slot_id, customer_phone)
7. AutoAI creates draft work order in Central Agenda and dispatches SMS confirmation link

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Customer Self-Service Online Booking via Website or SMS Link
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Customer visits garage website or clicks SMS link received from garage
step_by_step_journey: 1. Opens responsive 60-second booking page on mobile browser
2. Enters License Plate (e.g. AB-123-CD for France or GE 452 891 for Switzerland)
3. Selects desired service category (e.g. Oil Change & Safety Inspection)
4. Selects available date & time slot from live central calendar
5. Receives 10-minute temporary slot hold with active countdown timer
6. Enters full name, phone number, and checks GDPR consent
7. Clicks 'Confirm Booking' -> Instantly receives booking reference code and confirmation SMS/Email

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Reviewing & Approving Quotation via Magic Link in < 3 Minutes
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Receives SMS/Email notification: 'Your repair quotation DEV-2026-0089 is ready for review'
step_by_step_journey: 1. Clicks magic approval link -> Opens quote portal instantly without entering passwords
2. Reviews vehicle information, OBD diagnosis summary, and attached photos of worn brake pads
3. Inspects itemized parts (€140), labor (€110), and 20.0% TVA (€50) -> Total €300
4. Signs name on digital signature box and clicks 'Authorize Repairs'
5. Screen shows confirmation -> Workshop tablet immediately lights up green to commence work

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Rugged Tablet Diagnosis, OBD Fault Code Scan & Stopwatch Labor Tracking
step_by_step_journey: 1. Technician taps assigned Work Order on grease-resistant 48px touch screen
2. Taps 'Start Labor Stopwatch' -> System begins tracking active repair minutes
3. Plugs in OBD scanner -> Taps OBD Lookup -> Enters 'P0300'
4. Reviews fault description and suggested ignition coil / plug verification steps
5. Snaps photo of cracked ignition coil -> Uploads directly to work order
6. Completes 5-point digital checklist (Brakes, Fluids, Tires, Battery, Lights)
7. Taps 'Pause Stopwatch' -> Submits diagnostic findings for quote generation

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Cross-Border Repair with Swiss QR-Bill (CHF 8.1% MWST)
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Repairs completed on Swiss-registered BMW X5
step_by_step_journey: 1. Garage Admin generates invoice -> System detects Swiss address & IDE UID
2. Tax engine assigns 8.1% MWST and formats in CHF (CHF)
3. System compiles structured Swiss QR-Bill (BVR) with 27-digit payment reference and QR-IBAN
4. Admin prints or emails invoice PDF containing the official Swiss payment slip
5. Customer scans Swiss QR code using their Swiss banking mobile app (UBS, Credit Suisse, PostFinance) for instant settlement

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Transmitting French B2B Invoice via Plateforme Agréée (Pennylane PA)
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Commercial fleet repair finalized for French corporate client
step_by_step_journey: 1. Admin navigates to Invoices Hub -> Clicks 'Transmit to E-Invoicing'
2. Selects 'Plateforme Agréée (PA) — Pennylane'
3. System packages Factur-X XML data payload and dispatches to Pennylane API v2
4. Pennylane returns external tax tracking reference (FR-DEMO-2026-0085)
5. Invoice status changes to SUBMITTED -> Automatically updates to ACCEPTED upon DGFiP clearance
6. Customer and accounting records marked fully compliant

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Transmitting French Public Sector (B2G) Invoice via Chorus Pro (PPF)
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Municipal vehicle (Police / Town Hall) repair completed
step_by_step_journey: 1. Admin selects Work Order -> Generates invoice with French Public Sector Service Code
2. Clicks 'Transmit to E-Invoicing' -> Selects 'Chorus Pro (B2G)'
3. System validates mandatory SIRET and Chorus Pro Service Routing Code
4. Dispatches UBL 2.1 payload to French state Chorus Pro PISTE API at €0.00 cost
5. State portal confirms receipt and returns official submission ID

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Natural Language Symptom Intake via AutoAI Receptionist
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: Customer opens chat assistant: 'My car squeaks when braking at low speed'
step_by_step_journey: 1. AutoAI interprets symptom as brake system inspection requirement
2. AutoAI calls internal function check_workshop_availability(service='BRAKES')
3. Central Engine queries active brake technicians and 2-Post Lifts
4. AutoAI responds in French/English with 3 real available slots
5. Customer selects preferred slot -> AutoAI calls hold_booking_slot() with 10-min hold
6. Draft work order created in Central Agenda and SMS confirmation sent to customer

comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.scenario: Onboarding a New Garage Tenant with Isolated Database Workspace
comprehensive_user_flows_and_scenarios.trigger: New workshop subscribes to AtelierOS Pro Workshop Plan
step_by_step_journey: 1. Super Admin logs into SaaS Management Workspace
2. Taps '+ Onboard New Garage' -> Enters garage name, country (FR/CH), SIRET/UID, and currency
3. System provisions isolated PostgreSQL tenant schema with strict Row Level Security (RLS)
4. Default bays (2-Post Lift, 4-Post Lift), mechanic accounts, and tax rates (20% FR / 8.1% CH) seeded
5. Garage Admin credentials dispatched with secure activation link

third_party_api_matrix_and_cost_breakdow.disclaimer: All figures below are estimated baseline charges. Actual costs will vary based on garage volume, messaging frequency, and vendor plan selections.

services.purpose: Transactional dispatch of booking confirmations, magic quote approval links, Factur-X PDF invoices, and 24h appointment reminders.

services.production_cost_10_garages: €19.00 / month (Starter Plan up to 20,000 emails/month, covers 10 active workshops)
services.cost_variance_factors: Email volume spikes, dedicated IP add-on if requested.

services.vendor: WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta) & Brevo SMS / Twilio
services.purpose: Direct WhatsApp & SMS dispatch for instant magic link quote review (< 3 min turnaround) and vehicle pick-up readiness alerts.

services.purpose: Natural language symptom intake, OBD-II DTC diagnostic fault explanation, and bounded JSON tool calling.
